root_cause_confidence.confirmed: First T93 failure is absence of DevToolsActivePort before the 8000ms startup deadline, with spawned live Chromium and no stderr. CPU_PENDING was recorded in an overlapping aggregate sample; the sample does not prove that CPU pressure caused endpoint latency.
root_cause_confidence.hypothesis: Cold hosted Chromium/platform initialization may produce transient CPU pressure and variable endpoint latency; the combined macOS runner image/architecture may affect latency. Boundary confidence high; underlying cause confidence low.
not_proven: Extension background startup contribution before endpoint
Stale profile or test-mode setup defect

observation.limitation: ps CPU time displays centiseconds; snapshots bracket but do not equal the iostat interval. Exited, newly spawned, reparented, or PID-reused processes cannot be assigned exact interval CPU time.

appeared_process_lifetime_cpu_seconds.limitation: Lifetime totals for newly appeared processes, not exact interval deltas; transient/exited and reparented processes may be missing or misclassified.

code_boundary.profile: Every invocation mkdtemp plus new profile directory; prepareOwnedProfile refuses preexisting endpoint. No profile reuse.
code_boundary.endpoint: vault-owned-cdp.cjs repeatedly reads fresh-profile DevToolsActivePort; timeout precedes lock/process inspector or WebSocket creation. T93 longest read 270ms over 217 polls excludes a single blocked filesystem call as explanation.
code_boundary.setup: runNativeSidepanelQa verifies endpoint before extension worker, local fixture server, panel creation, identity/setup and exercisePanel. Panel setup cannot cause earlier endpoint absence; extension loading at browser spawn still could contribute.
code_boundary.resource: Admission measures a healthy prior 60s window, not future browser startup. CPU_PENDING is not immediate stop: failed child while pending makes final invalid; separate 380844 diagnostic later expired confirmation. This is intended verdict behavior, not evidence of broken admission.
code_boundary.sibling: ARM64 Chat and Data recovered CPU_PENDING and completed valid; Intel scrape 38099410087 also completed valid. Architecture alone is not a proven root cause.
code_boundary.gpu: Prior Intel diagnostic used GaneshGL / Apple Software Renderer, with disabled_software GPU compositing and unavailable_off rasterization/WebGL. This ARM64 diagnostic reports GraphiteDawnMetal / Apple Paravirtual device, and enabled compositing/rasterization/WebGL. Renderer differs alongside hardware/image; GPU causality remains unproven.

result.interpretation: The exact frozen v0.2.490 development artifact completed headed native startup and the existing guarded setup interval on ARM64 with the unchanged deadline. CDP connected at 01:10:34.547Z; CPU_PENDING at 0.99 busy was recorded afterward at 01:10:35.719Z and subsequently recovered.
